facts.fact: At the 4 August 2026 ceremony in Kinshasa the minister presented the PSEN for government validation, with presentation to the Council of Ministers for adoption announced for the coming days.
The PSEN is presented as guiding digital development to the 2030 horizon.
The minister said action plans still had to be finalised, and called on ministries to turn the PSEN into programmes with indicators and budget allocations.
The minister said a monitoring and evaluation mechanism and an interministerial steering mechanism were still to be set up after validation.
The PSEN passed government validation on 4 August 2026, with adoption by the Council of Ministers to follow.
